comment: Example configurations for omit attacks with correct message codes

attacks.name: OmitPrevSeals_InheritExtra
attacks.description: Omits 2 previous prepare seals when creating new block (InheritExtra phase)

attacks.name: OmitPrevCommitSeals_InheritExtra
attacks.description: Omits all previous commit seals when creating new block (InheritExtra phase)

attacks.name: OmitRoundChangeJustification
attacks.description: Omits RoundChange justification messages from PrePrepare after round change

attacks.name: OmitPrepareJustification
attacks.description: Omits 3 Prepare justification messages from PrePrepare after round change

attacks.name: OmitSealsBeforeBlockCommit
attacks.description: Omits all prepare seals before committing block (BeforeBlockCommit phase)

message_codes.1: MessageCodePrePrepare - Used in InheritExtra for prev seal omission
message_codes.16: MessageCodePropagation - Used in BeforeBlockCommit for seal omission
